experiment.title: Better Registration Audit
experiment.objective: Test whether a stronger registration stage reduces false positives and improves temporal consistency on VISO ship without changing the detector or the evaluation protocol.

notes: Always start with devsample before any full-dataset run on VISO.
Use the same split definitions and reporting protocol as v1_mmb_baseline_reproduction.
The controlled variable is the registration stage only.

phases.name: baseline_protocol_validation
phases.purpose: Verify that the follow-up experiment inherits the same scaffold and dataset contract as the baseline.

phases.name: follow_up_manifest_generation
phases.purpose: Freeze run manifests for the registration-only comparison.
